Screenprinted illustration with cream paper texture, bright yolk yellow, vermilion, dark green, a little turquoise; bold simple shapes readable as a game wall texture. Main text exactly 'KOGANE', secondary Japanese headline exactly 'おやつの時間！'. No prices, discounts, availability claims, cigarette/alcohol imagery, unrelated brand names or invented product packaging. Keep every letter intact inside generous trim-safe margins. Aim at an A2 portrait aspect ratio 420:594. Full poster, richly illustrated, not just a headline or blank rectangle.
